name: odu
//workspaces: odu became a workspace for ONE reason: packages/run-client is the half of odu a CLIENT of a live run holds (the fan-in surface + the dial), carved out so a downstream can subscribe a run cells by hydrating that directory alone — the arrangement kolu made for @kolu/padi-client. A workspace rather than a folder of relative imports because the wall has to be REAL: a package cannot depend back on odu, so the direction is physics rather than discipline, and packages/run-client/src/closure.test.ts walks the import graph to prove it. The member is listed in `dependencies` below as well as here: the isolated linker symlinks only the root package DIRECT dependencies into the root node_modules, so without that entry `@odu/run-client` would not resolve from src/.
//overrides: One effect instance, always. The @kolu/* sources are hydrated from the Nix store and resolve `effect` by walking up to this root node_modules (bunfig.toml explains the isolated-linker invariant), so a second copy arriving transitively would give kolu's _tag-based error narrowing two class realms to disagree about.
